# 1 Enoch Chapter 88 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams — Animal Apocalypse

---

**88:1** And-one-of-those-four-white-ones-came-to-me-and-took-me-by-my-hand-and-raised-me-up-and-set-me-down-on-the-side-of-those-sheep-far-from-them; and-he-gave-me-a-sword.

**88:2** And-I-saw-the-abyss-opened-in-the-midst-of-the-earth, full-of-fire, and-they-brought-those-blind-sheep, and-they-were-all-judged-and-found-guilty-and-cast-into-this-fiery-abyss, and-they-burned.

**88:3** Now-that-abyss-was-to-the-right-of-that-house.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Chapter 88 is brief — it depicts the judgment of the fallen Watchers (bound stars cast into fiery abyss) and transitions toward the Noah/flood narrative. The 'sheep' mentioned here are the beginning of the elect being distinguished from the wicked. The sword given to Enoch is unexplained but may signify authority to witness or execute judgment. Note: the full flood narrative with Noah/ark occurs across the transition of chs. 88-89.*
